atomone.manual_upgrade:
cd $HOME
rm -rf atomone
git clone https://github.com/atomone-hub/atomone.git atomone
cd atomone
git checkout v4.0.1
make install
sudo systemctl restart atomoned && sudo journalctl -fu atomoned -o cat
